lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six visible vertical columns of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, with centroid diameter increasing toward the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated intensity are visible across the mid-flank, intersecting with horizontal rows of blobs to form distinct anchor nodes in a rectangular lattice.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small high-luminance blobs scattered across the leading and middle sections of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch and tissue loss on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; distinct light-colored circular whorl pattern on the medial surface of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays an exceptionally dense, mottled cluster of small high-intensity pixels surrounding a central light-pigmented 'eye' or whorl-like feature.
